mechanism_failures: A direct extraction recovered Mississippi River Delta at the Gulf of Mexico, but a projection-free symbolic JOIN composed unrelated inverse edges and projected Saint Paul from the remote end of the proof path.
Binary extraction repeatedly omitted explicit event dates written as sentence modifiers even when the bound dependency, relation cue, and date co-occurred in one evidence sentence.
A correct locative output retained its trailing named input constraint, preventing atomic answer comparison.

architectural_delta.projection_preserving_join: Provider-free symbolic path JOINs require a verified target projection premise; the derived terminal value cannot switch to another open endpoint.
architectural_delta.temporal_projection: A provider-free date candidate is added only when a date query, bound dependency endpoint, matching relation cue, and explicit date co-occur in one evidence sentence.
architectural_delta.constraint_canonicalization: A trailing named locative constraint is removed from a direct wh-projection while the original tuple and exact evidence quote remain in provenance.

execution_order: opened causal diagnostic if any query-frontier regression appears
paired control/HARA Shadow-C20 without between-arm inspection if Smoke-A passes
stop_condition: Continue generic no-training diagnosis and iteration after any development failure. Stop only on the full preregistered HARA gate plus committed safe-stop report, or before the next call would exceed the shared 2000-attempt/2000000-token hard cap.
